Initial answers:
- Tokenized embed: we can support per-session tokens (we typically use short-lived JWTs attached to the embed URL). Need to confirm whether you require additional tracking parameters beyond email + sponsor_id.

- Zoom fallback: Zoom recordings will need a different path (post-processing watermark on the MP4) unless we run a custom overlay at the encoder level.

Hi all — quick technical note from events ops:

- ON24: supports tokenized embeds via query-string JWTs (we pass session_id + email hash). ON24 also supports client-side overlay watermarks rendered in the browser; for burned-in watermarks on recordings, we rely on the encoder to composite the overlay before recording. ON24's VOD export will reflect what the encoder outputs.

- Recommended approach (lowest risk): generate short-lived embed tokens (1 hour lifespan) and use ON24's overlay for the live session. In parallel, configure our encoder to composite the same overlay so the MP4 we receive has the watermark baked in.

- Zoom fallback: Zoom's cloud recording won't include browser overlays. If we fail over to Zoom, we will plan for post-processing burn-in. That adds ~24 hours to final MP4 delivery in our current workflow.

Attached is a short embed_test_plan.md with the steps we should run during the May 18 dry run (token generation, overlay verification, recording export check).

If BrightWave needs email printed exact (instead of hash) we should confirm privacy constraints — default is obfuscated.

I'll trigger a test with ON24 support.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Events Operations

Hi Lauren / Rachel / Alice —

Thanks for reaching out. Confirming ON24 can accept JWT-based session tokens on the embed URL (we validate signature + expiry). For per-viewer watermarking we support a client-side overlay that can include anonymized identifiers (example: BW-####).

Burned-in recording: ON24 will record the output as delivered by the encoder. If you are using ON24's multicast with our recommended encoder profiles, you can have the overlay composited server-side. If you require server-side burn-in at our end we need to open a ticket with engineering; that path incurs an extended turnaround.

See attached: on24_api_integration_guide.pdf (includes example JWT payload, recommended TTL, and overlay parameters). Support ticket opened: #ON24-75819 (please reference in your QA).
